title.zh: 初级无障碍前端开发人员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Implement semantic HTML and keyboard-accessible interface changes in a reviewed front-end workflow.
requirements.zh: 在经审核的前端流程中实施语义化 HTML 及可用键盘访问的界面修改。

requirements.en: Combine manual keyboard and screen-reader checks with careful triage of automated warnings.
requirements.zh: 结合人工键盘操作检查与屏幕阅读器检查，并审慎筛查自动化检测警告。

requirements.en: Document tests and explain changes during team review.
requirements.zh: 记录测试，并在团队评审中解释修改。

requirements.en: Preferred: develop production React applications with server-side account management.
requirements.zh: 优先：开发带服务端账户管理的生产级 React 应用。
